entity.scp_unleashed.scp529_cat.name: Josie
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp529.0: A friendly grey tabby keeps turning up at back doors, asking to be let in.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp529.1: Everyone who feeds her says she stops short somehow.
SCP-529, "Josie the Half-Cat": a grey tabby house cat who ends just behind her ribs. Josie gets about as though the rest of her were still there. Safe-class.
Josie is affectionate and curious. She belongs to nobody and takes no orders, but she warms quickly to anyone who shares a bit of fish.
She enjoys a gentle hand, though not everywhere. Mind what you feed her.
She never spawns naturally. Her file comes from the Archive.

dossier.scp_unleashed.529.title: Josie the Half-Cat
dossier.scp_unleashed.529.caption: SCP-529 on her favourite chair in the Level %r3%r break room. She agreed to the photograph for one sardine.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: No special precautions have yet proven necessary. SCP-529, known to staff as "Josie", is affectionate and free to roam the lower levels of the facility. She has never accepted an owner or a command, though she seeks out staff she is fond of.
Staff may feed SCP-529 fish. **Staff are not permitted to feed SCP-529 cheese.**
Personnel who wish to pet SCP-529 are advised to keep to her head and shoulders.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-529 is a small female house cat with grey tabby markings. Every part of her behind the end of the ribcage is missing. Her body stops sharply, as though sliced in two.
In spite of this, SCP-529 has no health problems and moves about as if her hindquarters were still in place.

The cut does not show the inside of the animal. It looks pure black to the eye and gives slightly to the touch. Her hindquarters are not invisible. A quick look confirms there is simply nothing there.
Some time after eating, SCP-529 scratches at the floor as though covering something up.

page.title: Addendum 529-1: Recovery
text: SCP-529 came to Foundation attention after a fishmonger in %rHarrowgate%r reported a stray that "wasn't all there". She walked out from behind the ice chests to meet the recovery agent and has shown no interest in leaving since.

page.title: Addendum 529-2: Note
page.text: Following Incident 529-03, in which a junior researcher shared half a cheese sandwich with SCP-529, the restriction on cheese is to be observed without exception. Dr. %rVale%r has asked for earplugs.
